# # YOLO26n Hyperparameter Tuning
# Executed on FPT AI Factory VM (Jupyter Notebook via SSH)
# Dataset: Ultralytics Platform (`ul://` URI)
# Model: yolo26n

# %% Environment Setup — install required packages
import subprocess
import sys

def _install(packages: list[str]) -> None:
    for pkg in packages:
        print(f"[SETUP] Installing {pkg}...")
        subprocess.check_call(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-U", pkg],
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        )
    print("[SETUP] All packages installed.")

_install(["ultralytics", "ray[tune]", "wandb"])

# %% GPU & Environment Verification
import torch
import os

print(f"[DEBUG] Python: {sys.version}")
print(f"[DEBUG] PyTorch: {torch.__version__}")
print(f"[DEBUG] CUDA available: {torch.cuda.is_available()}")

if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    raise RuntimeError(
        "No CUDA GPU detected. Hyperparameter tuning requires GPU. "
        "Check nvidia-smi on this FPT AI Factory VM."
    )

GPU_COUNT: int = torch.cuda.device_count()
for i in range(GPU_COUNT):
    name: str = torch.cuda.get_device_name(i)
    mem_gb: float = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(i).total_mem / 1e9
    print(f"[DEBUG] GPU {i}: {name} ({mem_gb:.1f} GB)")

print(f"[DEBUG] Total GPUs: {GPU_COUNT}")

# %% Configuration — EDIT THESE VALUES BEFORE RUNNING
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Ultralytics Platform API key (get from https://platform.ultralytics.com)
ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY: str = "YOUR_API_KEY"

# Dataset URI on Ultralytics Platform
# Format: ul://username/datasets/dataset-name
DATASET_URI: str = "ul://YOUR_USERNAME/datasets/YOUR_DATASET_NAME"

# Tuning budget
TUNING_EPOCHS: int = 30
TUNING_ITERATIONS: int = 50
IMAGE_SIZE: int = 640
BATCH_SIZE: int = 16

# Final training config (used after best hyperparams are found)
FINAL_EPOCHS: int = 100
FINAL_PATIENCE: int = 50

# W&B (optional — set to "" to skip)
WANDB_PROJECT: str = "YOLO26n-Vehicle-Tuning"
WANDB_API_KEY: str = ""  # leave empty to skip W&B logging
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

if ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY == "YOUR_API_KEY":
    raise ValueError(
        "Set ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY to your actual API key from "
        "https://platform.ultralytics.com/settings/api-keys"
    )

os.environ["ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY"] = ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY
print(f"[DEBUG] ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY set (length={len(ULTRALYTICS_API_KEY)})")
print(f"[DEBUG] Dataset URI: {DATASET_URI}")

# %% W&B Setup (optional)
if WANDB_API_KEY:
    import wandb
    os.environ["WANDB_API_KEY"] = WANDB_API_KEY
    wandb.init(project=WANDB_PROJECT)
    print(f"[DEBUG] W&B initialized — project: {WANDB_PROJECT}")
else:
    print("[DEBUG] W&B skipped (no API key provided)")

# %% Define Custom Search Space
from ray import tune

SEARCH_SPACE: dict[str, tune.search.sample.Domain] = {
    # Learning rate
    "lr0": tune.loguniform(1e-5, 1e-2),
    "lrf": tune.uniform(0.01, 0.2),
    # Optimizer dynamics
    "momentum": tune.uniform(0.7, 0.98),
    "weight_decay": tune.loguniform(1e-5, 1e-3),
    # Warmup
    "warmup_epochs": tune.uniform(1.0, 5.0),
    "warmup_momentum": tune.uniform(0.5, 0.95),
    # Augmentation — geometric
    "degrees": tune.uniform(0.0, 25.0),
    "translate": tune.uniform(0.0, 0.3),
    "scale": tune.uniform(0.2, 0.9),
    "fliplr": tune.uniform(0.0, 1.0),
    # Augmentation — color
    "hsv_h": tune.uniform(0.0, 0.04),
    "hsv_s": tune.uniform(0.3, 1.0),
    "hsv_v": tune.uniform(0.2, 0.7),
    # Augmentation — advanced
    "mosaic": tune.uniform(0.5, 1.0),
    "mixup": tune.uniform(0.0, 0.3),
    "erasing": tune.uniform(0.0, 0.6),
    # Mosaic close timing
    "close_mosaic": tune.choice([5, 10, 15, 20]),
}

print(f"[DEBUG] Search space defined — {len(SEARCH_SPACE)} hyperparameters")
for param_name in SEARCH_SPACE:
    print(f"  - {param_name}")

# %% Run Hyperparameter Tuning with Ray Tune
from ultralytics import YOLO

print("[DEBUG] Loading yolo26n.pt pretrained model...")
model: YOLO = YOLO("yolo26n.pt")

print(f"[DEBUG] Starting Ray Tune — {TUNING_ITERATIONS} iterations, {TUNING_EPOCHS} epochs each")
print(f"[DEBUG] Dataset: {DATASET_URI}")
print(f"[DEBUG] Image size: {IMAGE_SIZE}, Batch size: {BATCH_SIZE}")

result_grid = model.tune(
    data=DATASET_URI,
    space=SEARCH_SPACE,
    epochs=TUNING_EPOCHS,
    iterations=TUNING_ITERATIONS,
    imgsz=IMAGE_SIZE,
    batch=BATCH_SIZE,
    use_ray=True,
    gpu_per_trial=1,
    device=0,
)

print("[DEBUG] Tuning complete!")

# %% Analyze Tuning Results
import json

best_result = result_grid.get_best_result(metric="metrics/mAP50-95(B)", mode="max")
best_hyperparams: dict = best_result.config

print("=" * 60)
print("BEST HYPERPARAMETERS FOUND")
print("=" * 60)
for k, v in sorted(best_hyperparams.items()):
    if k in SEARCH_SPACE:
        print(f"  {k}: {v}")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Best mAP50-95: {best_result.metrics.get('metrics/mAP50-95(B)', 'N/A')}")
print(f"Best mAP50:    {best_result.metrics.get('metrics/mAP50(B)', 'N/A')}")

best_params_path: str = "best_hyperparams.json"
tuned_params: dict = {k: v for k, v in best_hyperparams.items() if k in SEARCH_SPACE}
with open(best_params_path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(tuned_params, f, indent=2)
print(f"[DEBUG] Best hyperparams saved to {best_params_path}")

# %% Final Training with Best Hyperparameters
print("[DEBUG] Starting final training with best hyperparameters...")

final_model: YOLO = YOLO("yolo26n.pt")

final_train_args: dict = {
    "data": DATASET_URI,
    "epochs": FINAL_EPOCHS,
    "imgsz": IMAGE_SIZE,
    "batch": BATCH_SIZE,
    "patience": FINAL_PATIENCE,
    "optimizer": "auto",
    "device": 0,
    "workers": 8,
    "amp": True,
    "save": True,
    "plots": True,
    "project": "runs/tuned",
    "name": "yolo26n_best",
    **tuned_params,
}

print("[DEBUG] Final training config:")
for k, v in sorted(final_train_args.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

final_results = final_model.train(**final_train_args)

print("[DEBUG] Final training complete!")
print(f"[DEBUG] Best model saved at: runs/tuned/yolo26n_best/weights/best.pt")

# %% Validate Best Model
print("[DEBUG] Running validation on test split...")

best_model: YOLO = YOLO("runs/tuned/yolo26n_best/weights/best.pt")
val_metrics = best_model.val(
    data=DATASET_URI,
    split="test",
    imgsz=IMAGE_SIZE,
    batch=BATCH_SIZE,
    device=0,
    plots=True,
)

print("=" * 60)
print("FINAL VALIDATION RESULTS (test split)")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"  mAP50-95: {val_metrics.box.map:.4f}")
print(f"  mAP50:    {val_metrics.box.map50:.4f}")
print(f"  mAP75:    {val_metrics.box.map75:.4f}")

per_class_map: list[float] = val_metrics.box.maps.tolist()
class_names: list[str] = ["bus", "car", "motor", "truck"]
print("\n  Per-class mAP50-95:")
for cls_name, cls_map in zip(class_names, per_class_map):
    print(f"    {cls_name}: {cls_map:.4f}")
print("=" * 60)
